name: Shane Riley
tagline: Reporting, writing, producing and broadcasting sports and local news across print, digital, television and radio.
shortBio: Shane Riley is a journalism student at Washington and Lee University, pursuing a career in journalism with a passion for sports and for sharing everyone's story in an ever-changing media landscape. He produces the Rockbridge Report newscast, calls W&L games on the Washington and Lee Sports Network, and reports for The Ring-tum Phi and The News-Gazette.
